title_en: 'Let Me Know If You Find Me' — Mandy's Actor Speaks Out As GTA 6 Releases Worldwide
summary_en: Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially released worldwide.
body_en:
Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially released worldwide.
GTA 6 is finally here, and players have wasted no time looking up the actors behind some of its colorful cast of characters. As the days go on, more and more performers are revealing that they played a part in the game — and one of these is going particularly viral due to a mystery surrounding their character.
The actor who plays Mandy, a character players encounter early in the game, identified herself as Lexie Shoaibi, an American model and actress based out of New York. She posted the news on her Instagram account on November 19, where she revealed that she provided both Mandy’s voice and motion capture.
“She’s a lot of fun, so if you play the game, let me know if you find me,” she said. In another post , Shoabi thanked Rockstar for casting her in the game, writing, “Y’all there aren’t words!!!! Thank you so much for the love and support. This is crazy!! Ily forever!”
Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead. Turn back now if you want to remain unspoiled!
Mandy is a character who’s been put under the microscope due to a few odd details that players noticed in her home. If you’ve played the first few hours of the game, you’ll know that Jason gets called over to collect rent from Mandy, who says she won’t pay up until her sink is unclogged. Jason finds the source of the clog — all while fending off aggressive romantic advances from Mandy — which appears to be a human fingerbone. Mandy snatches it from Jason’s hand and runs off with it before he can get a good look at what it really is.
A quick stroll through her home and backyard show even more disturbing bits, such as a body-sized hole in the back garden and tubs of acid. The trunk of her car has also been packed with tools that could feasibly be used to kidnap or kill a victim. With all this in mind, fans are convinced that Mandy is actually a serial killer who seduces her victims. (Jason’s loyalty to Lucia really paid off!)
Commenters were quick to praise Shoabi for her performance as Mandy and joke about her uncomfortable, one-sided crush on Jason, with one joking, “Why’d you do that to a committed man?”
“BRO. You had me in a chokehold, but I have to stay loyal to Lucia. Sorry Mandy!!” another said.
“Mandy listen… Look, I know we got off on the wrong foot, ok? Give me another chance,” another wrote.
If the serial killer theory is true, it means she might not be the only murderer around; fans also spotted references to Dexter in the game, prompting even more curiosity as to Mandy’s true intentions.
